sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Ember charge-port emulator: J12 connects the controller to the sensor harness in a charge-port signal emulator.
Operator note: an intermittent link interruption was reported during mating endurance.

No mating endurance test record accompanies this note.
Baseline revision and J12 pin mapping are not recorded.
Independent review is pending.
